summary: Defines the six composition layouts and the fixed order they rotate through in the selected work sequence.
purpose: Gives the work page a set of layouts to alternate between.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the comment about the sequence.
how: Declares the allowed layout names as a type, then lists them in rotation order.
outputs: The PreviewLayout type and the layoutCycle list.
risks: Renaming a layout breaks any code that still uses the old name. The type check only catches this where the type is used.
debug: If a layout looks wrong on the work page, compare its name in the page code with the names in this file.
